name: Israel Canada (T.R.) Ltd.
summary: Israel Canada (T.R.) Ltd., a real estate investments company, engages in the initiation, development, construction, execution, and sale of properties in Israel. It operates through Project Construction in Israel; Land in Israel; Investment Property in Israel; Hotels; Real Estate in Russia; and Others segments. The company is involved in the construction and sale of commercial areas and/or office areas and/or apartments; selling and/or marketing land; develops and leases land; and operation and provision of hotel services, as well as provision of management and consulting services in the field of hotels and tourism.
